decisions.reason: The passenger data transmission solution has an established government customer base and connects to over 30 APIS schemes, so it remains a core revenue-generating offer tied to ongoing regulatory requirements.
Demand for travel health requirements is weak after the pandemic, but the API is cheap to maintain and complements the document verification platform, so it stays for now under close review.
Behaviour analysis fits the firm's aviation security expertise and its strategy of combining technology with trained personnel, even though it is only mentioned rather than featured on the website.
The travel and document verification platform serves continuing airline compliance needs and is close to the firm's established offer, so it remains valuable.
